description: Northwind Digital, a fictional agency on reserved .example names (Agency; its card was declined at the 1 Nov renewal, so past_due inside the 7-day grace), and its client granitepeak.example, whose edge challenges every automated request from our published IPs, tagged or not. Browser rendering gets through, so the structure is crawled and Technical SEO shows; fewer than two scored crawlers could be measured, so AI readability is withheld with Access as a range (FACTS I4). One fix could not be verified, one waits on a re-check deferred by rate limiting, and a re-check failed. harborlight.example is a second, unremarkable client. Monday's client reports go out at 08:00 in each client's own zone. Kestrel Creative is a second agency on day 1 of its trial: only its name is set, and its first client site is queued for a first audit.

fixes.title: Let AI crawlers past the edge's automation challenge
fixes.detail: Every request from our published IPs got the same challenge, with or without a crawler user agent

context: Every request from our published IPs is challenged, with or without a crawler user agent, so the AI crawlers' own requests are likely challenged too.
change: Cloudflare › Security › Settings: lower the challenge for verified bots, or add IP access rules for the published IP ranges of the crawlers you want (each operator's IP list).
keep: Keep the challenge for unknown automation if you need it; only the crawlers you want need a way through.

verify.command: re-check this site once the rule is in place
verify.expect: the AI crawlers get 200 on the homepage
